Putin orders 72-hour ceasefire in Kyiv

Russian President Vladimir Putin has ordered a 72-hour ceasefire in Kyiv. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy welcomed US peace envoys to Kyiv following talks with Putin. The specific details regarding the implementation and scope of the ceasefire were not immediately clear from the reports.
